text_block_list.text:
Giving far beyond her best, El Condor Pasa 
conquered the Japanese Derby.

However... she is profoundly shocked to 
see Special Week grow far beyond anything 
she could have imagined.

Doubting her own strength, she frets over 
whether she truly has what it takes to fly 
out into the world, unable to head into 
the Japan Cup with full confidence.

Sensing that El Condor Pasa needed time to 
sort through her feelings, the Trainer—

Before moving on to the Japan Cup, it was 
recommended to run in the Mainichi Okan.
